$comment: Single source of truth for the hosting headers (CSP, frame, cache). web/build/live.py writes it to <live out>/vercel.json with https://YOUR-PROJECT.supabase.co / wss://YOUR-PROJECT.supabase.co replaced by DRUGBOX_SUPABASE_URL, and — only when DRUGBOX_SENTRY_LOADER is set — the Sentry loader/CDN hosts added to script-src and https://*.sentry.io to connect-src. deploy/vercel_deploy.sh deploys that folder. The page scripts are content-hashed same-origin files in js/ (script-src 'self'); a few small scripts and the approved page's onclick handlers stay inline, so script-src also needs 'unsafe-inline' (no 'unsafe-eval': the app never evaluates strings). index.html is no-cache (always the newest build); js/ and media/ never change under a name, so they are immutable. The local gateway (tools/local-supabase/gateway.mjs) sends the same policy for localhost.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://YOUR-PROJECT.supabase.co; media-src 'self' data: blob: https://YOUR-PROJECT.supabase.co; connect-src 'self' data: blob: https://YOUR-PROJECT.supabase.co wss://YOUR-PROJECT.supabase.co https://api.exchangerate.host; worker-src 'self' blob:; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
